notes_for_editor: Very thin evidence: the status and type come from the Forest Fire Lookout Association list; no build date, staffing or fire record was found in the sources read. The 9,273 ft figure is confirmed in the raw Peakbagging Table 1 row for Williams Valley (LO site): it sits in the EL, ft. column, followed by the BM value Spot. The trail guide covers the valley's forest roads and does not mention the lookout, so it is not evidence about the site itself. Whether the lookout site lies within the OHV network was not checked.
